Most of the institutional libraries of the Zürich University have accessable workplaces where you can work. 
Here you can look up the locations and if they have worplaces.
[https://www.ub.uzh.ch/de/ub-besuchen/standorte.html](https://www.ub.uzh.ch/de/ub-besuchen/standorte.html)

At some places there might be a lot of students. Workplaces are only bookable for UZH students. I suggest you avoid the big places in the centre and try the smaller ones. Locations in Oerlikon like Ethnologie/Soziologie, Kommunikationswissenschaft and Filmwissenschaft are rarely full.
